text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
My chest feels so hot... My heart is 
pounding, and power is welling up inside 
me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
They say the feelings of Umamusume dwell 
within the statue of the Three Goddesses, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Could this perhaps be... everyone's 
feelings and wishes...?
